original_description:
Ignite the essence of love with a luxurious blend of floral elegance and soft sensuality.

name: Green Scented Bauble - Irish Coffee
original_description:
Add a touch of festive charm with our Green Scented Bauble. Infused with the indulgent scent of Irish Coffee, it fills your home with the aroma of robust coffee beans, creamy milk, sweet vanilla, and a whisper of warm rum. A holiday treat that’s as cozy as it is captivating!
Handcrafted with the finest fragrance oils from Swiss perfume house Givaudan, certified coconut-soy blended wax, cotton wick.
For your safety: not for consumption, do not leave unattended. Keep away from draughts.

name: Enchanted - Baby Powder aroma melts
original_description: Handcrafted using natural coconut wax, ethically sourced, blended with virgin coconut oil, and infused exclusively with pure + plant-based baby powder scent. Our melts are long-lasting, absorb heat slowly, and they are a Lux alternative to a candle - the perfect way to enjoy the fragrance of a lit candle without the flame. Simply place your favourite melts into a wax warmer and enjoy!
